hero.subtitle: Restaurant discount and shuttle service for patients at the San Rocco Clinical Institute

intro.title: A point of reference
intro.titleItalic: For those close to the patients at the San Rocco Institute
intro.para: The Hotel Ristorante San Michele is located just 1.2 km from the San Rocco Clinical Institute. For patients undergoing hospitalization or surgery—and the family members accompanying them—we have arranged special benefits: a discount at the restaurant and a dedicated shuttle service.

sconto.title: Special discount for
sconto.desc: Patients who are hospitalized or undergoing surgery at the San Rocco Clinical Institute, as well as their family members, are eligible for a special rate and are exempt from the tourist tax.
sconto.footerLabel: For information about the special discount

navetta.title: Free shuttle
navetta.desc: Guests at the Hotel San Michele who need to get to the San Rocco Clinical Institute can take advantage of the dedicated shuttle service. Transportation is arranged directly by the front desk upon reservation.
navetta.footerLabel: Book the shuttle at the front desk or contact us

items.title: Proximity to the clinic
items.desc: Just 1.2 km from the San Rocco Clinical Institute. A three-minute drive—absolute convenience for families and patients.

items.title: Local Cuisine
items.desc: The restaurant serves signature Lombard cuisine. A moment of quality, even on the busiest days.

items.title: Shuttle service upon request
items.desc: The hotel-to-clinic shuttle service is available to all guests. Simply let the front desk know when you check in.

dove.title: San Rocco Clinical Institute —
dove.para: The clinic is located on the same street as the hotel, a three-minute drive away. The front desk at Hotel San Michele is available to assist with any transportation needs or to provide information.
dove.distanza: ~3 minutes · 1.2 km from the San Rocco Institute

cta.title: Are you here to visit a family member who is hospitalized?
cta.para: Contact us: We'll explain the restaurant's special discount and arrange a shuttle service for your transportation.
